Additionally, both the `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` updates omit mention of `error.cause`, which was a primary requirement of the ticket. Finally, the candidate places its tests in a separate `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` file (and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree) rather than extending `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` like the reference.
